component.name: immich
component.description: TAPPaaS module immich: triage of its own critical/high CVEs (#788). Immich 3.2.4 (from nixos-unstable) on NixOS: immich-server on :2283 plain HTTP, published through the firewall's Caddy to home, netbird and internet zones, ML service on 127.0.0.1:3003, PostgreSQL local, redis on a unix socket only. VM firewall opens only 22 and 2283 (a microservices worker also binds 0.0.0.0:33293 but the firewall blocks it). Verified live on hrossen: the immich Node processes load libraw 0.22.1, libtiff 4.7.2 and ImageMagick via vips (sharp) for thumbnails, so any user upload reaches them; libssh comes only via ffmpeg's sftp support; openssl 3.5.8 is loaded by Node and the Python ML worker as TLS clients only. All listed libraw/libtiff CVEs are fixed in the shipped upstream versions, the ImageMagick ones are 2014/2017 bugs long fixed, and no OpenSSL QUIC/DTLS/TLS-server path exists on the VM.

analysis.detail: SUN coder error handling fixed in ImageMagick 6.8.9 (2014); 7.1.2-31 contains the fix, the match comes from a version-less CVE record.
deflate_dng_load_raw integer overflow (TALOS-2026-2364) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit aa4458e, Debian marks 0.22.1-1 fixed); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.
uncompressed_fp_dng_load_raw overflow (TALOS-2026-2363) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit c911c9b); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.
Debian/Ubuntu packaging bug (Lua loaded as a dynamic library, exposing package/loadlib); nixpkgs builds redis with its bundled Lua and this Immich instance listens only on a unix socket.
Concerns an unofficial Windows port (dbghelp.dll search path); upstream Redis on Linux is not affected.
Double free in profile.c fixed in 6.9.7-4 / 7.0.4-4; 7.1.2-31 contains the fix.
HuffTable::initval overflow (TALOS-2026-2330) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit 5357bb5); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.
lossless_jpeg_load_raw overflow (TALOS-2026-2331) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit 75ed2c1); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.

libssh is linked only into ffmpeg (jellyfin-ffmpeg, opencv's ffmpeg) for the sftp:// protocol; Immich hands ffmpeg local file paths only and never connects to an SSH server, so the channel callback path never runs.
Server-side GSSAPI key exchange flaw; libssh is used only as an ffmpeg sftp client here, and the VM's SSH server is OpenSSH.
TIFFReadRGBATileExt heap overflow fixed by commit 5155851 (MR 546), first released in libtiff 4.7.0; the shipped libtiff is 4.7.2.
putcontig8bitYCbCr44tile overflow fixed by commit 782a11d6, which is in the v4.7.2 tag (Debian marks 4.7.2-1 fixed); the shipped libtiff is 4.7.2.
QUIC stack packet-buffer retention; nothing on the immich VM uses OpenSSL's QUIC stack (immich-server and the ML service speak plain HTTP, outbound HTTPS from Node is TCP TLS).
Needs a TLS server that swaps SSL_CTX mid-handshake with differing provider sigalgs; no process on the immich VM serves TLS with this OpenSSL (TLS ends at the firewall's Caddy, :2283 is plain HTTP).
DTLS retransmission bug; nothing on the immich VM speaks DTLS.
QUIC NEW_CONNECTION_ID flood; nothing on the immich VM uses OpenSSL's QUIC stack.
memalign alignment overflow in glibc 2.30 to 2.42 (the CVE's own text); NVD's range has no upper bound, and immich's glibc 2.44 carries the fix.
strfmon width padding overflow, real in glibc 2.44; only reachable if a program calls strfmon with right-justified padding — immich's Node and Python services do not. Kept counted as glibc is.

ratings.justification: risk in this deployment, from the triage

analysis.detail: Disputed upstream (a stack-guard bypass that needs an existing overflow); the record names no affected versions. Kept counted as glibc is.

Signed integer overflow in the MOV/MP4 demuxer's HEIF ispe box: immich probes (ffprobe) and transcodes every uploaded video, and immich is published to the internet — reachable by any user with a login, as the immich user. Not in FFmpeg 8.1.3 (fixed upstream in 059eb2e, FFmpeg 9.0); jellyfin-ffmpeg 8.1.3-1 runs here (#807).

ratings.justification: risk in this deployment, from the triage

analysis.detail: Out-of-bounds read from unpadded IAMF extradata in the MOV demuxer (mov_read_iacb): immich probes (ffprobe) and transcodes every uploaded video, and immich is published to the internet — reachable by any user with a login, as the immich user. A read past a buffer, not a write. Not in FFmpeg 8.1.3 (fixed upstream in 8439e02, FFmpeg 9.0).

ratings.justification: risk in this deployment, from the triage

analysis.detail: The WMA encoder (libavcodec/wmaenc.c); immich encodes audio only as AAC or Opus, never WMA.
The RTSP client; immich gives ffmpeg uploaded local files only, and ffmpeg's protocol whitelist for a file input does not open rtsp.

DVB subtitle parser signed overflow (libavcodec/dvbsub_parser.c): fixed in FFmpeg 8.1.3, which jellyfin-ffmpeg 8.1.3-1 is built on — 46ef25c9c, cherry-picked from 93f2a525e. NVD's range (before 9.0) misses the 8.1 backport.

CineForm HD transform-2 out-of-bounds write (libavcodec/cfhd.c): fixed in FFmpeg 8.1.3, which jellyfin-ffmpeg 8.1.3-1 is built on — ea7210860, cherry-picked from db05df9d1. NVD's range (before 9.0) misses the 8.1 backport.
